The cultivar is responsible for an entire family of modern crosses — the original frost-blanketed, fruit-candy bag appeal that built the modern Runtz category. Effects Runtz delivers a balanced experience that pairs uplifting cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels social and pleasant — suitable for daytime use, group settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of broadly-pleasing character that earned this strain its modern legend status. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sugary candy sweetness up front, with tropical fruits through the middle and a subtle floral-creamy finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably bright. The terpene profile reads candy-and-tropical-fruit — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Runtz harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Runtz THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Runtz THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains.
